# Creating a command

Commands are declared with `defineCommand`, `defineOption` and `defineArgument`, on top of `cliparse`. Options and arguments are validated and parsed by [Zod](https://zod.dev) schemas, and their types flow into the handler. The reasons behind this design are explained in [ADR 0001](../adr/adr-0001-rework-file-structure.md).

Before writing a command, look at a similar one and copy its naming, file layout, output format and error messages. `src/commands/drain/` is a good example of a command group with shared arguments and options.

## Example

A fictional `clever coffee brew <blend>` subcommand, part of a `coffee` group (neither exists in the CLI). The `<blend>` argument is shared by several `coffee` subcommands, so it lives in `coffee.args.js`:

```js
// src/commands/coffee/coffee.args.js
import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineArgument } from '../../lib/define-argument.js';

export const blendArg = defineArgument({
  schema: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes'),
  description: 'Blend of coffee',
  placeholder: 'blend',
});
```

`--shots`, `--milk` and `--topping` are only used by this subcommand, so they are defined inline. `--format` comes from `global.options.js`:

So the field names (`name`, `description`, `url`, `picture`, `baseUrl`, `rights`) and the 11 right names come from what I know of the API, not from a live response.
- **One doc doesn't match the code.** `docs/contributing/api-client.md` says `ids-resolver.js` resolves OAuth consumers, but no such code exists.

Here's what I plan to add, copying the `k8s` and `ssh-keys` commands:

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/oauth-consumers.js` | The list of rights, a lookup by key or by name (with an error if the name matches several consumers), owner resolution from `--org`, and the Console path (`/users/me/oauth-consumers/<key>` or `/organisations/<id>/oauth-consumers/<key>`) |
| `oauth-consumers.command.js` | Group with no handler of its own, `since: null` |
| `.list` / `.get` | `--org` and `--format json`. `get` also has `--with-secret`, which fetches the secret separately |
| `.create <name>` | `--base-url`, `--url`, `--rights a,b` (checked against the list of rights) are required; `--description` and `--picture` are optional |
| `.update <key\|name>` | Same options, all optional. It fetches the consumer, merges the changes and sends the full object back |
| `.delete <key\|name>` | Asks for confirmation; `--yes` skips it |
| `.open <key\|name>` | Opens the consumer in the Console |
| `.args.js` / `.options.js` | Arguments and options shared by several subcommands |
